purpose: Machine-readable release registry for research objects, derived fields, and caveat namespaces.

release_buckets.admit_now: May enter formal default research surfaces when source/provenance is preserved.
release_buckets.admit_with_explicit_caveat_only: May be consumed only through explicit caveat metadata or a caveat namespace.
release_buckets.admit_top_of_book_only: May be consumed only as bounded top-of-book replay objects, never as full reconstructed depth.
release_buckets.keep_out_for_now: Not released for downstream research consumption; tracked only as a blocked object.

object_types.raw_field: A raw stage field released only under a precise semantic boundary.
object_types.derived_field: A derived object produced from stage fields, replay state, or DQA state.
object_types.caveat_namespace: A materialized namespace whose tables carry explicit caveat metadata.

objects.derived_logic: Interpret only as vendor lifecycle event code in replay: 1=Add, 2=Modify, 3=Delete.
forbidden_claims: official native message semantics are fully confirmed
queue depletion or fill realism can be inferred from OrderType alone
OrderType may enter verified default tables without caveat metadata
downstream_boundary: Use only with explicit caveat metadata.
Do not treat the event code as official native event semantics.
objects.blocker: event_semantics_inference remains blocked; official native message identity has not been proven.

objects.derived_logic: Derive from Ext[0]: 0=BID, 1=ASK. No other Ext bits are released.
allowed_uses: order side proxy in orderbook replay DQA
forbidden_claims: full Ext semantics are verified
OrderSideVendor is an official native side field
OrderSideVendor may enter verified default tables without caveat metadata
downstream_boundary: Only Ext[0] is released.
Ext[1], full Ext, Level, and queue semantics remain outside this object.
objects.blocker: Need larger multi-day confirmation before upgrading from vendor side proxy to stronger semantics.

objects.derived_logic: For each trade, check whether non-zero BidOrderID / AskOrderID refers to an active replay order with expected side.
forbidden_claims: BidOrderID / AskOrderID native meaning is fully confirmed
verified_trade_order_linkage is released as a default table
execution fill simulation is supported
downstream_boundary: Only consume as DQA evidence or replay caveat evidence.
Do not publish as official trade-to-order native linkage truth.
objects.blocker: Native trade-field identity and full depth semantics remain unverified.

objects.derived_logic: On modify events, compare VolumePre with the prior active replay volume for the same OrderId.
forbidden_claims: VolumePre is a verified queue-ahead field
VolumePre supports queue-position alpha
VolumePre may enter verified default tables
downstream_boundary: Use as prior-active-volume consistency evidence only.
Do not use as queue position or depth truth.
objects.blocker: VolumePre native semantics are not fully confirmed and queue semantics remain blocked.

objects.derived_logic: Materializes lifecycle_events and trade_linkage evidence tables with explicit caveat metadata; does not output reconstructed depth.
allowed_uses: input evidence for crossed-book residue investigation
forbidden_claims: reconstructed depth is admitted
top-of-book or full book replay is strategy-ready
Level, full Ext, BrokerNo, BidVolume, or AskVolume semantics are released
downstream_boundary: Allowed as caveat-only DQA materialization.
Not a verified default table and not a reconstructed-depth feed.
objects.blocker: Reconstructed depth remains blocked until crossed-book residue is explained or bounded by contract-level thresholds.

objects.derived_logic: Flag replay windows where replay best bid is greater than replay best ask.
allowed_uses: quality gate inputs for top-of-book experiments
forbidden_claims: crossed windows are harmless without threshold evidence
full reconstructed depth is admitted
strategy replay may ignore crossed residue
downstream_boundary: Use as a DQA exclusion/risk flag only.
Do not convert into a pass condition without contract thresholds.
objects.blocker: Contract-level crossed-window threshold is not frozen.

objects.derived_logic: Flag replay records or windows that contribute to unexplained crossed-book or linkage residue.
forbidden_claims: residue source is fully explained
residue-free depth reconstruction has been proven
flagged windows can be silently dropped in strategy backtests
downstream_boundary: Use for DQA attribution and review routing only.
Excluded-window policy must be separately documented before backtest use.
objects.blocker: Residue taxonomy and exclusion contract are not yet frozen.

objects.derived_logic: Minimal bounded gate emitted by the top-of-book builder: 1.0 only when TopOfBookValidFlag=true; 0.0 otherwise.
allowed_uses: default research filtering inside the explicit top-of-book namespace
manual review prioritization for invalid replay windows
forbidden_claims: the score is sufficient for strategy admission
the score can replace crossed-book residue analysis
the score proves full reconstructed depth or queue semantics
downstream_boundary: Consume only with the full top-of-book flag set visible.
Treat 0.0 as not default-consumable, not as a negative alpha signal.
objects.blocker: Only the minimal 0/1 quality gate is released; richer scoring and thresholds remain blocked.

objects.derived_logic: Flag replay windows excluded from bounded top-of-book experiments after an explicit exclusion rule is chosen.
forbidden_claims: excluded windows can be hidden from reports
exclusion makes full depth valid
exclusion policy is frozen without a dossier
downstream_boundary: Every exclusion rule must be report-visible and resumable.
Exclusions cannot be used to hide failed full-depth semantics.
objects.blocker: Specific exclusion rule and threshold need contract review.

objects.derived_logic: Flag same-millisecond event clusters where order/trade ordering may affect replay state.
allowed_uses: manual review of vendor batch behavior
forbidden_claims: same-millisecond ordering is solved
SeqNum/TickID ordering alone is sufficient for all replay windows
strict causality or fill realism is released
downstream_boundary: Use as an ordering-risk flag only.
Do not collapse the flag into a final event-ordering proof.
objects.blocker: Need representative multi-day ordering study and contract-level tie-break rule.

objects.derived_logic: Materializes top_of_book_events with best bid/ask, spread, mid, trade-inside-book flag, and explicit quality gates; does not output full depth.
allowed_uses: bounded spread and mid descriptive checks
trade-inside-best-book reporting with visible quality gates
forbidden_claims: full reconstructed depth is admitted
queue semantics or execution realism is released
Level, full Ext, BidVolume, or AskVolume semantics are verified
downstream_boundary: Allowed only as a top-of-book-only caveat namespace.
Every row must carry quality flags and full depth must remain blocked.
objects.blocker: Crossed-book residue and ordering risk still block full reconstructed depth; top-of-book use must remain gated.

objects.derived_logic: Best active bid from caveat replay state after top-of-book validity gates.
allowed_uses: trade-inside-best-book checks when TopOfBookValidFlag is true
forbidden_claims: full reconstructed depth is released
queue position or fill priority is known
strategy-ready replay exists without crossed-residue gating
downstream_boundary: Consume only with TopOfBookValidFlag=true and visible quality flags.
Do not derive depth ladder or queue metrics from this object.
objects.blocker: Top-of-book contract thresholds and crossed-residue policy are not frozen.

objects.derived_logic: Best active ask from caveat replay state after top-of-book validity gates.
allowed_uses: trade-inside-best-book checks when TopOfBookValidFlag is true
forbidden_claims: full reconstructed depth is released
queue position or fill priority is known
strategy-ready replay exists without crossed-residue gating
downstream_boundary: Consume only with TopOfBookValidFlag=true and visible quality flags.
Do not derive depth ladder or queue metrics from this object.
objects.blocker: Top-of-book contract thresholds and crossed-residue policy are not frozen.

objects.derived_logic: ReplaySpread = BestAskReplay - BestBidReplay when top-of-book gates pass.
forbidden_claims: negative or crossed spread is acceptable without flagging
spread proves full order book correctness
spread can be used for execution realism without caveat
downstream_boundary: Use only when TopOfBookValidFlag is true.
Persist crossed/invalid spread metrics in reports.
objects.blocker: Crossed spread threshold and exclusion policy are not frozen.

objects.derived_logic: ReplayMid = (BestBidReplay + BestAskReplay) / 2 when top-of-book gates pass.
forbidden_claims: mid-price is a production replay reference price
mid-price can support alpha without replay quality caveats
full depth has been reconstructed
downstream_boundary: Use only under top-of-book gates and visible caveat metadata.
Do not treat as a production reference price.
objects.blocker: Top-of-book validity contract is not frozen.

objects.derived_logic: Flag whether trade Price falls inside [BestBidReplay, BestAskReplay] when top-of-book state is valid.
forbidden_claims: inside-book flag proves full book correctness
outside-book trades can be hidden without residue accounting
trade execution realism is released
downstream_boundary: Use as top-of-book sanity evidence only.
Always report numerator, denominator, excluded windows, and caveat flags.
objects.blocker: Need formal denominator/exclusion policy for invalid top-of-book windows.

objects.derived_logic: Boolean gate for using top-of-book replay objects; true only when best bid/ask are present and quality flags allow consumption.
forbidden_claims: TopOfBookValidFlag releases full depth
top-of-book validity implies queue validity
invalid windows may be silently excluded
downstream_boundary: Every downstream top-of-book object must carry this flag or equivalent metadata.
False or missing values cannot be used as a default pass.
objects.blocker: Validity thresholds and same-millisecond ordering policy need contract review.

objects.derived_logic: Full depth ladder reconstruction is intentionally not released.
forbidden_claims: reconstructed depth is verified
Level is a reliable ten-depth field
queue position, fill simulation, or execution realism is admitted
downstream_boundary: Do not consume as a research object.
Use this entry only to keep the blocker explicit.
objects.blocker: Crossed-book residue remains non-zero and Level/full-depth semantics are not verified.
